title: FP8 calibration: seed diversity + latency-sensitivity validation for E4M3/E5M2
creator: Anika Shah
description: Background: FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) activation selection on Hopper has improved cost/throughput but remains sensitive to calibration seed selection and request latency profiles. Several recent canaries showed intermittent token-level degradation correlated with narrow calibration seeds and high tail-latency microbursts. Goal: create a repeatable calibration workflow that exercises seed diversity, models latency-sensitive inputs, and produces deterministic pass/fail signals for automated canary gating. Non-goals: redesigning quant kernels or changing hardware scheduling heuristics (separate initiatives).
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible calibration pipeline that runs N=12 diverse seeds across stratified holdout sets and emits a single 'calibration_score' per run
Calibration_score stability threshold defined: median relative log-likelihood delta <= 0.8% vs FP32 baseline across all holdouts
Latency-sensitivity subtest added: synthetic microburst traces (99th/99.9th percentile) exercised during shadow inference and metrics recorded
Automated canary gate: if any of 12 seeds exceed degradation thresholds or latency-sensitive metrics regress beyond configured hysteresis, runtime automatically pins to INT8 variant and alerts SRE/ML
End-to-end integration: CI job that runs golden-seed smoke, deploy canary with telemetry, and a dashboard that surfaces per-layer noise and seed variance
rollout_plan: 1) Build stratified calibration datasets (conversational, code, summarization, instructions) and assemble N=12 seeds that vary RNG, batching order, and sample permutations. 2) Implement 'seed-diversity' stage in calibration service that produces per-layer noise histograms and global calibration_score. 3) Add latency-sensitivity harness that replays recorded microburst traces against candidate profile in shadow mode. 4) Wire calibration_score + latency metrics into canary gating (console + SRE webhook). 5) Run cross-region canaries on a small cohort of customers, hold for 72h, run regression analysis, then progressive rollout. 6) If gate trips, automated rollback to INT8 variant and create incident with attached fingerprints.
telemetry_requirements: calibration_score: median relative log-likelihood delta vs FP32 (stringified)
per_layer_noise_std: list of top-10 layers by variance
seed_variance_pct: percent variance across N seeds
latency_p99 and p99.9 under synthetic microbursts
end-to-end token-error spike events (counts) during shadow runs
comments: 2025-11-06 - Initial scoping: determined N=12 seeds gives stable empirical variance across our evals; referenced ENG-314271 golden-suite for holdouts.
2025-11-18 - Design review with ML Research: agreed to use relative log-likelihood delta as primary signal; per-layer noise used for triage only.
2025-12-02 - Engineering spike completed: seed orchestration implemented in calibration-service; first run shows a 0.95% median delta on summarization holdout (above target).
2025-12-12 - Tweaked seed generation to include permutation stratification and batch-order shuffles; median delta improved to 0.6% on local runs.

2026-01-03 - Added latency-sensitivity harness using recorded trace set from infra/latency-traces (region-us-west2); observed p99.9 uplift of 12ms under FP8 vs INT8 in worst-case microburst for long-seq prompts.
2026-01-10 - PM review (Sofia K.): asked for clearer rollback SLA and customer communication template; included in rollback_playbook_ref.
2026-01-15 - Current: wiring canary gate into deploy pipeline; running cross-region shadow canaries for 48h; next update after 72h observation period.
notes: Decision: use conservative hysteresis (two consecutive failing runs OR one severe outlier) before automated rollback to minimize flip-flopping. Follow-up: schedule tabletop with SRE and Support to rehearse customer comms if rollback triggers.
next_steps: Complete cross-region 72h shadow canaries, validate telemetry alert thresholds with SRE, finalize PRs for gating, and schedule staged rollout in runtime-1.22 if green.
